newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain employers meet unions, continue talks Friday.
newsitem.headline: Spain employers meet unions, continue talks Friday.

text.p: Spanish employer groups and union representives are to meet on Friday to continue trying to reach an agreement on the reform of the labour market, a spokeswoman for employers association CEOE told Reuters on Thursday.
They are discussing ways to tackle unemployment and liberalise what is still a rigid labour market.
Prime Minister Jose Maria Aznar said on Wednesday he expected to see an agreement on the reform within days.
But unions say the talks are not making progress.
The government has given the two sides until around the start of March to come to a deal or it will impose one upon them.
